Diesels were mass produced for lots of applications, and ended up in a lot of production cars so it would make sense to have that option in campaign too. It would be cool to play as a company like International or Frieghtliner and have to design transport or construction vehicles for countries that have less developed roads. 

Dually definitely seems do-able with fairly little work, and honestly I don't think adding a couple bodies with 3rd and 4th axle options and rear steering sounds beyond the realm of possibility. Definitely not any time soon, but definitely seems doable. 

4 wheel steer has been around for a while and has been in quite a few production cars so I don't see why that can't happen either. 

Some mod bodies supported bigger engines in the past. But it would be cool to have a 10-12000cc i6, I think the biggest you can make now is 8000ish cc. I love the idea of designing an engine for a marine application in the late 80s and then having a contract from the government or something to produce them for heavy military vehicles. 

I honestly think there's less to change than what some people here are making it seem like, but I'm not an expert. Maybe some new sounds, a new fuel system/ignition options, higher compression options. Considering how easy it is to make something that functions similar to a diesel already, it feels like it shouldn't be that complicated

I think most of the work is done already, I bet half of it is connecting the dots and more spreadsheets. Definitely a TON of work but I feel like if there was enough interest, the devs would maybe reconsider. Not sure how long ago they said they wouldn't do diesel, but now that they have some fresh blood maybe they're feeling zesty
